fusions.name: Lullaby Shriek
fusions.desc: Lets out a low shriek across a cone 4 tiles long that deals 12 resonating damage, stuns everything in it for 1 second and leaves it [Muddled] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Quiet Nip
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 4 dark damage to the first enemy it meets, heals you for 25% of the damage dealt and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Daylight Roost
fusions.desc: Veils you and every ally near you for 10 seconds and restores 12 health. Enemies notice you 65% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Nocturnal Habit
fusions.desc: At night, your armour rises by 12%. You have +5% dodge chance at all times.
